_comment: Pre-declared taboo set for the cartographer-duty-format assay. class: first_principles = the hazard is derivable by analyzing the repair act itself; corpus_empirical = its badness is only apparent from accumulated observation; meta_routing = it sits upstream of the act; session_close = it fires on session close, not on the repair act. scan_target = whether the cartographer meta-taboo scan (routing-class + session-close-obligation-class) is designed to surface it. markers = case-insensitive keyword cues a rule scorer uses as a coverage proxy; the Claude judge is the semantic measure.

taboos.divergence_point: Repair begins without a confirmed locus record naming file, line, and failure mode.
A fix attempt begins before a passing criterion is declared.
A change touches lines the confirmed locus did not name.
The fix is applied to a call site or consumer, leaving the canonical source unchanged.
A second fix attempt follows a failed one without a revised root-cause citation.
The repair is declared complete without a co-located verification artifact.
Verification is by written claim rather than an observed test result or output.
Repair execution begins before routing is confirmed.
An advisory fix is accepted without a durability check confirming a caller cannot bypass it.
An environmental constraint discovered during repair is not recorded before the session closes.
